body: @borela Can you please have a look at this? Thanks!

@thanosp Your example does not work with PHPUnit 5.6:
```
$ phpunit GeneratorTest
PHPUnit 5.6.8 by Sebastian Bergmann and contributors.

W                                                                   1 / 1 (100%)

Time: 39 ms, Memory: 4.00MB

There was 1 warning:

1) Warning
The data provider specified for GeneratorTest::testGeneratorProvider is invalid.
Data set #0 is invalid.

WARNINGS!
Tests: 1, Assertions: 0, Warnings: 1.
```
@thanosp Your example works with PHPUnit 5.6 when I change `yield 'testing';` to `yield ['testing'];`.

issue.title: Make getDataFromDataProviderAnnotation aware of generators.
issue.body:
This method was skipping generators as mentioned in the issue #2380 which
would cause tests to fail.

body: @sebastianbergmann I created a [pull request](https://github.com/sebastianbergmann/phpunit/pull/2381), the test you added passed with that patch, the issue was that [generators were being skipped](https://github.com/sebastianbergmann/phpunit/pull/2381/commits/4dcb2c8623526d86236beba1a2942124e7e794ee#diff-d2b0b699e9f0cfd6bd35cb3338167223R479).
